title: The Content Machine (Free) | Elvin Peters
description: The full 51-page Content Machine guide, free by email. Publish AI content at volume without it all sounding the same.
label: Free: the full 51-page guide
headline: Publish AI content at volume without it all sounding the same
tagline: My first 200 AI pieces all started their titles with the same word, and I only saw it when I counted. This 51-page guide is the system I'd have built on day one: five components you set up in an afternoon and nine steps you run every week.
bullets: Catch the sameness before your readers do, with a counting check that found 200 of my 200 titles opening with "The".
Build the five components once (the brief, the rotation, the voice rules, the gate and the queue), then keep it running in thirty minutes a week.
Let a scoring gate turn down weak drafts before you read them, so only work that clears your bar goes out under your name.

thanks_text: I've sent you a short email. Click "Yes, that's me" and the guide follows in a second email, with a private download link that works for 7 days. Nothing there in a few minutes? Check your spam folder.
